registration.deadline: 90 days after installation for the cited eligible U.S. residential enhanced/Consumer Choice coverage; exceptions and product terms apply. Verify the unit certificate.
registration.who_may_register: Homeowner/customer or dealer/contractor; the official Carrier and Bryant registration forms each present both roles.
registration.portal_accepts_dealer: yes - both official registration forms offer `Customer/Equipment Owner` and `Dealer/Contractor` as registrant choices.
registration.terms_allow_third_party_preparation: uncertain - please check; dealer registration is explicitly supported in the portal, but the reviewed public pages do not specify whether an outside service may prepare data for a dealer.

date_code.format: No general Carrier/Bryant HVAC serial-number date-code format was found in the official pages reviewed. Carrier says a serial number often contains manufacture date; do not parse it without model-specific manufacturer guidance.
